findings.title: ApiReturnedLeaderboardPage Error arm ignores the vacancy-id guard - a late page error from vacancy A clears leaderboard_loading_more on vacancy B
findings.detail: Ok arms guard on leaderboard_vacancy_id but `Error(_), _, _` resets loading_more unconditionally. Residual of the r3 guard work (the plain handler's Error arm was fixed; the page handler's was not). Impact: spinner stops early; B's own response still lands.
findings.recommended_fix: Guard the Error arm on model.leaderboard_vacancy_id == Some(vacancy_id), mirroring ApiReturnedLeaderboard.

findings.title: Real session-restore cold-boot leaderboard tag (the r3 blocker fix on the live path) has no test pin
findings.detail: Fix verified-landed by read; demo cold-boot is pinned (demo_cold_boot_deep_link_tags_leaderboard_test) but no ApiReturnedSession Ok test asserts leaderboard: Loading + leaderboard_vacancy_id: Some(id). The r3 blocker escaped through exactly this class of unpinned set-site. Demoted from the tests lens's blocker: the fix itself is confirmed present and the miss class is not the r4 hard-blocker contract.
findings.recommended_fix: Add an ApiReturnedSession(Ok) test on a VacancyDetail boot asserting the tag and Loading are set alongside the fetch.

findings.title: ApiReturnedLeaderboardPage vacancy-id guard is new and completely untested
findings.detail: No test references ApiReturnedLeaderboardPage; both the Ok-guard drop and the (unguarded) Error arm would survive a revert. Pairs with W1.
findings.recommended_fix: Add update-level tests: late page for other vacancy dropped; matching page appended.

findings.title: vacancy_detail pb-28 compare-bar padding still untested (still present since round 1)
findings.detail: application_detail's pb-28 is now pinned (application_detail_reserves_room_when_comparing_test); vacancy_detail's equivalent remains unpinned.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a vacancy_detail view test asserting pb-28 present when comparison_ids non-empty, absent when empty.

findings.recommended_fix: Add a leaderboard_view render test asserting filter pills carry shrink-0.

findings.title: [approved-design] Live application-notification deep link no-ops unless the owning vacancy's leaderboard is on screen
findings.detail: Confirmed behavior, but it is the documented, user-approved client-side resolution choice ('the click degrades to a no-op rather than navigating somewhere wrong'). Notification is still marked read. Not re-litigated; recorded for visibility.
findings.recommended_fix: None this round; a server-side vacancy id on notification creation would remove the gap.

findings.title: Post-mutation leaderboard refetch (approve / bulk-reject) is silently dropped when cold-booted directly onto an ApplicationDetail page
findings.detail: These fetch dispatches rely on the tag already being set; on a cold boot to /vacancies/:v/applications/:a the tag is None, so the refetch response is dropped. Self-heals: board stays NotAsked and the next vacancy-page visit refetches. Impact limited to sweep-nudge banner freshness.
findings.recommended_fix: Optional: set leaderboard_vacancy_id alongside these refetches, or accept the self-healing drop.

findings.title: md:justify-end on active pipeline rail but not rejected/auto-closed rails (still present since round 1)
findings.detail: Unexplained asymmetry; pipeline rail right-aligns on desktop, siblings don't.
findings.recommended_fix: Add md:justify-end to the other rails, or comment the intentional difference.

findings.title: Redundant Error fallback arm in ApiReturnedLeaderboard guard
findings.detail: `Error(_err), _ ->` matches a strict subset of the following `_, _ ->`; both no-op. Harmless documentation value.

findings.title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
findings.detail: P0 pins landed and bite (late-response drop, Error-arm guard, both entity-type paths, demo cold boot). Gaps: live session-restore cold-boot pin, LeaderboardPage guard pin, two carried r1 view pins. Gate: P0 ~100% landed-fix behavior verified by read; pin coverage <90% on new guards.
